colophon.iast: Composed by Peyalvar, one of the three Mudhalazhwars ("first Alvars") whose Tiruvantatis open the Iyaṟpā section of the Naalayira Divya Prabandham. No Tamil-script source found yet — English romanization only for now.

lines.iast: inRE kazhal kaNdEn Ezh piRappum yAn aRuththEn
pon thOy varai mArbil pUndhuzhAy anRu
kazhal thozhudhum vA nenjE kArkkadal nIr vElai
pozhil aLandha puLLUrdhich chelvan ezhil aLandhangu
seRivennum thiN kadhavam semmi maRai enRum
mARpAl manam suzhippa mangaiyar thOL kai vittu
varungAl iru nilanum mAl visumbum kARRum
nerungu thI nIr uruvum AnAn porundhum
nErndha en sindhai niRai visumbum vAyndha
avai seydhu ari uruvum AnAn sevi theriyA
kAN kAN ena virumbum kaNgaL kadhirilagu
padai paravai pAzhi pani nIr ulagam
uLan kaNdAy uLLuvAr uLLaththu uLan kaNdAy
mannu maNi mudi nINdu aNdampOy eNdhisaiyum
malai mugadu mEl vaiththu vAsugiyaich chuRRi
thalai mugadu thAnoru kai paRRi alai mugattu
aNdam pOy nIr theRippa anRu kadal kadaindhAn
sUzhndha thuzhAyalangal sOdhi maNi mudi mAl
thennilagaik kOn vIzhach chenRu kuRaL uruvAy
muyanRu thozhu nenjE mUri nIr vElai
kariya mugil idai min pOla thiriyungAl
iRai uruvam yAm aRiyOm eNNil niRaivudaiya
vAzhum vagai aRindhEn mai pOl nedu varai vAy
thAzhum aruvi pOl thAr kidappa sUzhum
viNNagaram vehkA viri thirai nIr vEngadam
Angu malarum kuviyum mAl undhi vAy
pArththa kaduvan sunai nIr nizhal kaNdu
nINda thOL mAL kidandha nIL kadal nIrAduvAn
pugumadhaththAl vAy pUsik kIzh thAzhndhu aruvi
nalamE validhu kol nanju Uttu van pEy
vehkAvE sErndhAnai meymmalar thUyk kai thozhudhAl
Edhu gadhi Edhu nilai Edhu piRappu ennAdhE
kaLLaththAl maN koNdu viN kadandha paingazhalAn
kaviyinAr kai punaindhu kaNNAr kazhal pOy
thozhil koNdu thAn muzhangith thOnRum ezhil koNda
madhu ninRa thaN thuzhAy mArvan podhu ninRa
maganAm avan magan than kAdhal maganai
siRai seydha vANan thOL seRRAn kazhalE
imam sUzh malaiyum iru visumbum kARRum
